recognize_zh: 背景為核仁明顯的芽細胞；左側一個芽細胞的細胞質空泡內含一顆深染的小圓核（被吞噬的有核細胞），右下角另有類似的吞噬現象，屬芽細胞吞噬血球（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Many medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio and round to indented nuclei
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm, some with cytoplasmic blebs
Blast (left) containing an engulfed small cell with a dense round nucleus inside a vacuole; a second similar phagocytic blast at lower right
Background of red cells and scattered small dark nucleated cells (likely late erythroid precursors or lymphocytes)
describe_en: Smear shows numerous blasts with fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm. At least two blasts contain engulfed nucleated cells with dense pyknotic-appearing nuclei within clear vacuoles, consistent with hemophagocytosis by leukemic blasts. The phagocytic cells retain blast nuclear features rather than those of mature macrophages. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with blast hemophagocytosis; flow cytometry for monocytic markers and cytogenetics for t(8;16) KAT6A::CREBBP are recommended.

ddx.vs: HLH macrophages are large mature cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and bland condensed nuclei, and the background lacks a blast population.
Morphology overlaps (monocytic blasts with hemophagocytosis); the diagnosis requires demonstrating the KAT6A::CREBBP rearrangement.
Emperipolesis is seen within mature megakaryocytes and the engulfed cells are intact and non-degenerated.
Cannibalistic tumor cells are cohesive and non-hematopoietic, lacking the dispersed blast population seen here.
